text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ has won the showdown
against her
sister at the Arima Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As Нарита Брайан comes over to
congratulate her,
Biwa Hayahide has one
question.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
"Am I a big sister you can be proud of
now?"
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан's response? "I've always
been proud
of you." Today, our winning
equation has finally
given Бива Хаяхидэ
the victory she's dreamed of
for so long.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
